action: Backport upstream 35f75d2a46e5 (the fix NVD lists) and also 107ed84602bb ('ext4: Fix zalloc()'), which NVD does not list. On this 64-bit target 35f75d2a46e5 alone is not enough: __builtin_add_overflow(u32, 1, &size_t) does not detect the wrap because 0x100000000 fits in a 64-bit size_t, so a 0xffffffff inode size becomes zalloc(0x100000000). That exceeds the 4 MiB heap (CONFIG_SYS_MALLOC_LEN=0x400000), memalign() returns NULL, and zalloc() in fs/ext4/ext4_common.h then runs memset(NULL, 0, 4 GiB) because it has no NULL check. 107ed84602bb switches to kzalloc(), which checks. Also apply the CVE-2024-57258 dlmalloc fixes. Both commits applied cleanly with git am on the BSP 7.8.0 tree; not build-tested, not runtime-tested. No configuration-only mitigation: CONFIG_FS_EXT4 is needed by the Toradex boot flow.

action: Upgrade to Toradex BSP 7.8.0 or later, or add recipe patches 0001 and 0002 from meta-toradex-bsp-common commit 2ed62810 (equivalent to upstream 3059eb0c27dd + 2092322b31cc) to the u-boot-toradex_2024.07 recipe. Then check that every image referenced by each signed configuration is listed in sign-images and has a hash node, because the fixed verifier fails closed. Also take the Binarly FIT-verifier fixes (no CVEs): Binarly reported six FIT-verifier bugs without CVEs (BRLY-2026-037 to -042, June 2026). Their upstream fixes, all first in v2026.10-rc1, are absent from every BSP 7 release: f3d2ff3f5c3f 'fdt: Check return value of fdt_get_name() calls' (BRLY-2026-037/038, rated possible code execution) and 7304d569e615 'fdt_region: Check return value of fdt_get_property_by_offset() calls' apply cleanly to the BSP 7.8.0 tree; e73328612534 'image-fit-sig: Validate hashed-strings region size', 69f6272b24a2 'image-fit: Validate external data offset and size' and 9e0d2fb42965 'image-fit: Limit recursion depth in fdt_check_no_at()' do not apply as-is and need adapting. None of these was build-tested here. They matter only with FIT signature verification enabled. Yocto cve-check will still report CVE-2026-46728 as unpatched on 7.8.0, because Toradex's patch carries no 'CVE: CVE-2026-46728' tag and the recipe sets no CVE_STATUS; add CVE_STATUS[CVE-2026-46728] = "backported-patch: fixed by 2ed62810 in BSP 7.8.0" in your own layer if you are on 7.8.0.
